pages.text: Grow a coffee tree and harvest coffee seeds. Process the seeds into raw beans with the Thermal Grinder, roast them in a furnace, then grind the roasted beans into coffee powder. The Coffee Machine turns that powder into espresso and milk foam.

pages.title: Coffee Seeds
pages.text: Coffee seeds plant the four-stage coffee tree on dirt, grass blocks, or farmland. A mature tree returns one seed when harvested; process it in the Thermal Grinder to obtain a raw bean.
